name: echo ssh hd
description: Proposal, the 60 cell remake of echo ssh (8 px cells, the creature at 3x behind a little desk with its own monitor and keyboard, a grey tower with a screen, LEDs and a port at its right, a cable from the desk along the floor into the port): it types a prompt line of dashes and a block cursor, a gold key leaves the desk and slides along the cable to the port, the key turns and the padlock on the remote screen opens while the wire goes solid teal, packets stream both ways while the remote screen fills with scrolling lines and its LEDs walk, the antenna pings with arcs and the eyes shut happy, then the padlock shuts, the wire goes dark from the far end back and it leans back; judge whether someone who knows ssh reads key, handshake, session and close without a caption, whether the tower reads as a machine, and whether it is still this creature. Host plays it when an agent opens a remote session.
